tools.name: get_scoring_grid
tools.description: Returns every factor, band and point value of the Ontario Workforce Priority Stream EOI scoring grid, with the grid version, the date it was last checked against ontario.ca, and the official source URL.

tools.name: calculate_oinp_score
tools.description: Estimates an Ontario Workforce Priority Stream Expression of Interest score from a profile, with a factor-by-factor breakdown. Omitted fields score 0. Unofficial estimate.

tools.name: convert_language_test_to_clb
tools.description: Converts IELTS General Training, CELPIP-General, PTE Core, TEF Canada (either the Score / 699 or the Équivalence ancien score column) or TCF Canada ability scores to CLB levels using IRCC equivalency tables. The overall level is the lowest of the four.
